subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android Chat permanently add a dedicated inline Dictation control alongside Voice Note and Talk once the stacked ownership work and successful-recognition proof are resolved?
rationale: The patch adds a new first-class composer and microphone mode; code review can assess mechanics, but only the Android product owner can confirm that this control belongs in the supported mobile interaction model.

options.title: Sponsor inline dictation
options.body: Approve the product direction, require the stacked base to land or be extracted, and request recognizer-enabled before-and-after proof on the rebased head.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the composer-ownership fix separate and pause this PR until Android voice and composer UX direction is decided.

options.title: Decline the control
options.body: Close the feature PR while preserving the independent session-safe composer work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109200.

recommendation.title: Sponsor inline dictation
recommendation.body: Approve the product direction, require the stacked base to land or be extracted, and request recognizer-enabled before-and-after proof on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly routes Android app ownership to @obviyus, and the decision concerns Android composer and voice UX.
